rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 478px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
RX→VF0 慢速路径:
1、PORT收包，Switch命中默认混杂规则导向uplink
2、uplink VSI→PF netdev(NAPI)→Bridge
3、Bridge查表决策→vf0 repr netdev
4、vf0 repr ndo_start_xmit→metadata_dst(VF0_VSI)
5、Switch按metadata投递到VF0 VSI→vf0 netdev

rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 321px; margin-left: 2px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1、switchdev模式下没有l2规则，默认导向uplink
2、为每个vf添加TX慢速规则，目的为repr vsi对应的qp
3、repr netdev发送时会填入对应VF的vsi

div.div:
RX→VF0 慢速路径:
1、PORT收包，Switch命中默认混杂规则导向user uplink
2、user uplink VSI→PF port(poll)→Bridge
3、Bridge查表决策→vf0 repr port
4、vf0 repr port tx_pkts→metadata_dst(VF0_VSI)
5、Switch按metadata投递到VF0 VSI→vf0 netdev

div.div:
1、dpdk切换非流隔离模式，及将慢速转发路径导到用户态处理
a、uplink切换到user pf uplink
b、repr切换到user_esw_vsi
2、repr port发送时会填入对应VF的vsi

div.div:
VF0→VF1 慢速路径:
1、VF0发包 Switch流表miss，命中慢速规则
2、命中慢速规则→FWD_TO_Q(esw_vsi,qp0)
3、NAPI上送repr_vf0→Bridge决策
4、Bridge转发repr_vf1 ndo_start_xmit
5、metadata_dst(VF1_VSI)→Switch→VF1
